rank_definition: 1 plus number of strictly higher scores; exact ties share rank.

definitions.clean_seeds: All 250 uploaded rows cut at this seed, replayed over 100-999.
definitions.band_seeds: All 250 uploaded rows return HDR, replayed over 100-999.
definitions.candidate_window: Historical 150-seed circular slice of 100-399 at offset 30*i for h0-h9, confirmed by original stride-30 plan logs and replay.
definitions.missing_archive: h0/h4/h5/h6 have no task upload archives and zero valid experiments in the API. Actual submitted sets cannot be reconstructed.

h0.candidate_window_basis: Original ten-hotkey stride-30 layout from the historical plan logs, checked against uploaded bands.
h0.status: No received-task/upload event or task archive found; API reports zero score and zero valid rows. Prepared band is unverified against submitted rows.
